target.statement: VS3D achieves PSNR 22.51 on the Objaverse-derived editing benchmark (Table 1).

compute.basis: The paper reports 57 s per asset on an RTX 4090 and uses multiple test-time DiT forward/backward passes for RASI, PMG sampling, and TAR twins; reproducing the aggregate Table 1 metric requires the full benchmark on GPU, and CPU-only execution is effectively infeasible.

blockers: No code release or repository link is provided in the paper.
The Objaverse-derived editing benchmark, edit pairs, human masks, reference renderings, and instructions are not stated to be publicly released.
Requires the frozen TRELLIS 2.0 three-stage DiT backbone plus DINOv3-L and SC-VAE checkpoints, which are not linked.
Test-time per-step optimization (RASI) and multi-sample PMG make CPU-only inference impractical; paper uses an RTX 4090.
The headline Table 1 result is an aggregate over the whole benchmark, so a single-asset reproduction is not sufficient.
title: Velocity-Space 3D Asset Editing
